title: Ride the Rides
intro: [mischievously] Please keep your arms and legs inside the vehicle at ALL times... Welcome in to Disney Jeopardy! Tonight we are riding the rides. Coasters, dark rides, [laughs] and songs you will NOT get out of your head.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a dazzling theme-park skyline at dusk: a white cone-shaped space dome, a red-rock mine train mountain, a snowy peak coaster, spinning teacups and a pirate ship flying over glowing city lights, all lit with neon ride lights

categories.title: To Infinity and Beyond
categories.intro: Our film category has inspired more rides than I can count. It's Pixar's Toy Story films. [excited] Reach for the SKY!

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a kid's bedroom from a toy's-eye view: wall wallpaper of blue sky and fluffy clouds, a toy rocket, wooden blocks and a cowboy hat on the bed

clues.clue: What is the name of the boy who owns Woody and Buzz in the first Toy Story?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Andy. His name is LITERALLY written on Woody's boot. [chuckles] Free points.

clues.clue: The three-eyed aliens in the Pizza Planet crane game worship what?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Claw. It moves. It chooses who will go and who will stay. [whispers] Ooooh.

clues.clue: In Toy Story 2, Woody learns he was the star of which 1950s TV show?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Woody's Roundup. [chuckles] Yodel-ay-hee-hoo! Jessie, Bullseye, and the Prospector were all there too.

clues.clue: What is the name of the toy store owned by Al, the toy collector in Toy Story 2?
clues.reveal: And the correct answer is Al's Toy Barn. [mischievously] Bonus points if you can do the chicken suit commercial voice.

clues.clue: What is the name of Sid's scary dog in the first Toy Story?
clues.reveal: Drumroll, please... the correct answer is Scud. Buster is Andy's dog. Scud is the reason no toy wants to visit the neighbors.

categories.title: Coaster Crazy
categories.intro: This category is for the THRILL seekers. [laughs] Hands up for some Disney roller coasters!

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a twisting roller coaster track racing through a snowy Himalayan mountain and a gem-filled mine at sunset, motion blur and sparks

clues.clue: Seven Dwarfs Mine Train in Magic Kingdom is themed to which classic film?
clues.answer: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
accept: snow white and the seven dwarfs
choices: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs. [laughs] Heigh-ho, heigh-ho, it's off to the standby line we go.

clues.clue: Expedition Everest at Animal Kingdom is guarded by which legendary snowy creature?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Yeti. He is giant, he is angry, and he really does not want you on his mountain.

clues.clue: Slinky Dog Dash zooms around which land at Disney's Hollywood Studios?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Toy Story Land. [laughs] You are shrunk down to the size of a toy in Andy's backyard. Watch out for giant Woody.

clues.clue: On Magic Kingdom's TRON Lightcycle Run, riders lean forward on vehicles shaped like what?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is lightcycles. It's one of the fastest coasters at Walt Disney World. Hold on to your hat. Actually, put the hat in the locker.

clues.clue: Space Mountain first launched riders in 1975 at which Disney park?
clues.reveal: [gasps] Oh, this one is TOUGH. The correct answer is... Magic Kingdom. [chuckles] Disneyland didn't get its own Space Mountain until 1977. Florida was FIRST for once!

categories.title: Ride Tunes: Finish the Lyric
categories.intro: [excited] Sing it with me! I'll give you a lyric from a classic attraction song, and you finish it. Bonus points for singing out loud... [chuckles] your family will love it.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: giant colorful musical notes floating over a little boat ride through a world of dancing dolls, tiki drums and a moonlit haunted manor

clues.clue: Pirates of the Caribbean: Yo ho, yo ho, a pirate's life for ___.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is me. [mischievously] A pirate's life for me! Drink up, me hearties, yo ho.

clues.clue: Walt Disney's Enchanted Tiki Room: In the Tiki Tiki Tiki Tiki Tiki ___.
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is room. All together now, in the Tiki Tiki Tiki Tiki Tiki Room!

clues.clue: It's a Small World: It's a world of laughter, a world of ___.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is tears. [laughs] A world of hopes and a world of fears, too. Very emotional for a boat ride.

clues.clue: It's a Small World: There's so much that we share, that it's time we're ___.
clues.reveal: [whispers] Only the true Disney nerds got this one. The correct answer is... aware. It's a small world after all. [sighs] Sorry, it's going to be in your head all week.

clues.clue: Haunted Mansion: When the crypt doors creak and the tombstones quake, grim grinning ghosts come out to ___.
clues.reveal: [dramatic pause] And the correct answer is... socialize. [laughs] Even ghosts need a party. Grim Grinning Ghosts was sung by Thurl Ravenscroft and friends.

categories.title: Which Park Is It In?
categories.intro: Every one of these attractions is at Walt Disney World. [mischievously] Your job? Look at the picture and tell me which of the four parks it calls home.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: four glowing theme-park icons in one panorama: a fairytale castle, a giant silver geodesic sphere, a hollywood-style water tower and a giant sculpted tree of life

clues.clue: At Walt Disney World, Test Track lets you design and test your own car in which park?
clues.reveal: And the correct answer is Epcot. Zoom zoom. Just like REAL life, your car design is probably not as good as you think.

media.prompt: Original illustration, 16:9, vivid colors, theme-park concept-art style, no text, no logos, no characters, no people: a sleek futuristic concept car speeding along a test track at night with glowing blue speed lines and a sensor tunnel

clues.clue: At Walt Disney World, Kilimanjaro Safaris takes guests on a bumpy ride past real African animals in which park?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney's Animal Kingdom. [chuckles] Every ride is different, depending on which animals are awake.

media.prompt: Original illustration, 16:9, vivid colors, theme-park concept-art style, no text, no logos, no characters, no people: an open-sided safari truck bumping along a dirt road past elephants, a baobab tree and a savanna sunrise

clues.clue: At Walt Disney World, The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror drops guests in a haunted hotel elevator in which park?
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is Disney's Hollywood Studios. [mischievously] Check in to the Hollywood Tower Hotel. Check out is optional.

media.prompt: Original illustration, 16:9, vivid colors, theme-park concept-art style, no text, no logos, no characters, no people: a crumbling 1930s Hollywood hotel tower with a broken neon-free sign frame, struck by lightning in a purple night sky

clues.clue: At Walt Disney World, Remy's Ratatouille Adventure shrinks you down to rat size in which park?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Epcot, in the France pavilion. You get to scurry through Gusteau's kitchen in 3D. Delicious.

media.prompt: Original illustration, 16:9, vivid colors, theme-park concept-art style, no text, no logos, no characters, no people: a giant-scale Parisian restaurant kitchen seen from a tiny rat's-eye view, huge copper pots and enormous cheese wheels

clues.clue: At Walt Disney World, The Barnstormer, a junior coaster starring Goofy as a stunt pilot, is in which park?
clues.reveal: [dramatic pause] The correct answer is... Magic Kingdom, over in Storybook Circus. [laughs] Great first coaster for the little ones.

media.prompt: Original illustration, 16:9, vivid colors, theme-park concept-art style, no text, no logos, no characters, no people: a red barn with a crop-duster biplane crashing through its roof beside a small kid-sized roller coaster in a circus-themed fairground

categories.title: All Aboard!
categories.intro: Club DJ chose ride vehicles! Teacups, doom buggies, honey pots... [laughs] tell me what you're riding in, or who's driving.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a whimsical lineup of empty ride vehicles: a giant pastel teacup, a black clamshell-shaped buggy, a honey pot car and a flying pirate ship

clues.clue: On the Mad Tea Party, guests spin around in giant what?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is teacups. [whispers] Pro tip, do not eat a turkey leg right before this ride.

clues.clue: On Peter Pan's Flight, guests soar over London in a flying what?
clues.reveal: And the correct answer is a pirate ship. [laughs] Think happy thoughts and sprinkle a little pixie dust.

clues.clue: The ride vehicles in the Haunted Mansion are known as what?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Doom Buggies. Please keep your hands inside, the hitchhiking ghosts are watching.

clues.clue: At Magic Kingdom's The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh, riders bounce along in giant what?
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is hunny pots. Spelled H U N N Y, the Pooh way. Oh bother.

clues.clue: Mickey and Minnie's Runaway Railway is a wild train ride. Which character is the train's engineer?
clues.reveal: Drumroll, please... the correct answer is Goofy. [mischievously] Which explains why the train ends up LITERALLY everywhere but on the tracks.
